rationale: DS.AI.010 directly excludes AI-based systems whose risk directly contributes to potential fatalities or multiple life-threatening injuries and some online-learning cases. That supports the document-scope portion. The inference that the hypothetical flight-critical DAA case lies outside the proposal remains untested until the function has an aircraft-level failure-condition allocation; vehicle context alone cannot perform that mapping.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-002-R1, EASA NPA 2025-07(B), PDF p. 4, DS.AI.010 Scope
limitations: No functional hazard assessment or DAA failure-condition allocation is included for REL-AIR-001.
The cited material remains proposed; this review does not classify a real DAA implementation.
